title: P5 Synthetic Study Laboratory trajectory (v1)
description: A frozen evaluation fixture for #215 P5. 'documents', 'operations' and 'current_state' are the only inputs: operations are materialized through existing production write boundaries into a disposable workspace (a labeled legacy-shape operation is the only direct SQL), and the production Lineage projection, Capability Registry evaluator and Guided Study Cycle decide every result. 'expected' is never passed to production; it is compared afterwards. Synthetic text only; no provider or model call; no real workspace; not study history.

planned_profile.description: The #215 P5 trajectory description. Descriptive only; never an evaluator input.

fixture_class.description: lawful: every operation uses a production write boundary. lawful_then_legacy_shape: lawful operations followed by an explicitly labeled direct-SQL legacy shape (audit §12: legacy fixtures are not proof a user workflow can produce the state).

policy.description: The production rule versions the expectations were derived from. A mismatch refuses evaluation; fixtures are re-frozen deliberately, never silently.

documents.description: Synthetic documents: one sentence per line becomes one extraction block and one compiler Observation.

operations.description: Applied in order. Boundaries: upload=POST /api/upload; set_governing_question=PUT /api/investigation; mark=POST /api/reader/highlights; inquiry=POST /api/observations/<id>/inquiry; save_perspective=POST /api/perspective/saved; retain_perspective_run=POST /api/perspective/run + /retain (in-process fake adapter); steward_interpretation=SQLiteStore.insert_interpretation (steward-authored); model_proposal=POST /api/e10/interpretations/generate (in-process fake adapter); accept_proposal=POST /api/e10/proposals/<id>/accept; ratify_blueprint=POST /api/pipeline/ratify-blueprint; exclude_document=PATCH /api/documents/<id>/scope; legacy_drop_table=labeled direct SQL.

current_state.description: The only explicit current-state inputs the production evaluator accepts (P1 contract).

declared_lineage.description: Exact expected Study Lineage item counts keyed 'table|event|authorship'. Equality proves no history is manufactured or lost.

coverage.description: Explicit coverage limits; must equal the production Lineage coverage of the materialized workspace.

edges.description: Edge conditions this trajectory discriminates (partial history, unsupported coverage, superficially similar evidence).

capabilities.description: All 11 capabilities. availability = production P1 current readiness (available | not_yet_available | unsupported_due_to_missing_history); status = production P1 historical status (adds already_exercised_under_supported_evidence); guide = production P2 step state (ready | currently_supported | historically_exercised | not_ready | unknown).

reason.description: Deterministic reason, stated in terms of declared evidence and the governing rule.

derivation.description: The authority rule the expected recommendation follows from.
